blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 3.5
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 3.5

blocks.text: नाडीसंहारभूतजयभूतकैवल्यभूतपृथक्त्वानि
blocks.directed: [slowly] नाडीसंहारभूतजयभूतकैवल्यभूतपृथक्त्वानि

blocks.text: Nāḍīsaṃhāra-bhūtajaya-bhūtakaivalya-bhūtapṛthaktvāni.
blocks.directed: Nāḍīsaṃhāra-bhūtajaya-bhūtakaivalya-bhūtapṛthaktvāni.

blocks.text: Withdrawal of the subtle channels; mastery of the elements; isolation from the elements; separation from the elements.
blocks.directed: Withdrawal of the subtle channels; mastery of the elements; isolation from the elements; separation from the elements.

blocks.text: Śiva Explains the Cosmic Plumbing System.
blocks.directed: Śiva Explains the Cosmic Plumbing System.

blocks.text: Look at the length of this thing.
blocks.directed: Look at the length of this thing.

blocks.text: Vasugupta has suddenly remembered Sanskrit allows compounds.
blocks.directed: Vasugupta has suddenly remembered Sanskrit allows compounds.

blocks.text: He’s gone from two-word philosophical explosions to what appears to be the password for a particularly secure monastery.
blocks.directed: He’s gone from two-word philosophical explosions to what appears to be the password for a particularly secure monastery.

blocks.text: But the sūtra is important because it introduces a series of yogic operations.
blocks.directed: But the sūtra is important because it introduces a series of yogic operations.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja understands these through the interconnected disciplines of breath regulation, concentration, withdrawal and absorption.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja understands these through the interconnected disciplines of breath regulation, concentration, withdrawal and absorption.

blocks.text: Let’s work through them.
blocks.directed: Let’s work through them.

blocks.text:
Nāḍīsaṃhāra — Withdrawal of vital movement
Nāḍī refers to a subtle channel through which prāṇa, vital energy, is understood to operate in traditional yogic physiology.
blocks.directed:
Nāḍīsaṃhāra — Withdrawal of vital movement
Nāḍī refers to a subtle channel through which prāṇa, vital energy, is understood to operate in traditional yogic physiology.

blocks.text: Saṃhāra means withdrawal or reabsorption.
blocks.directed: Saṃhāra means withdrawal or reabsorption.

blocks.text: Now, according to the relevant tantric model, ordinary vital activity operates through differentiated channels and functions.
blocks.directed: Now, according to the relevant tantric model, ordinary vital activity operates through differentiated channels and functions.

blocks.text: Among the familiar terms are:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Among the familiar terms are:

blocks.text: Prāṇa — one principal form of vital movement.
blocks.directed: Prāṇa — one principal form of vital movement.

blocks.text: Apāna — another, associated with downward-moving or eliminative functions.
blocks.directed: Apāna — another, associated with downward-moving or eliminative functions.

blocks.text: Udāna — an upward-associated vital function, especially important in these subtle-body accounts.
blocks.directed: Udāna — an upward-associated vital function, especially important in these subtle-body accounts.

blocks.text: And the central channel:
blocks.directed: [short pause] And the central channel:

blocks.text: Suṣumṇā.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Suṣumṇā.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja describes the reabsorption of vital movement into the middle channel, involving the relation between prāṇa and apāna and the central function of udāna.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja describes the reabsorption of vital movement into the middle channel, involving the relation between prāṇa and apāna and the central function of udāna.

blocks.text: He cites detailed breath-regulation methods from the Svacchandatantra.
blocks.directed: He cites detailed breath-regulation methods from the Svacchandatantra.

blocks.text: These include inhalation, exhalation, retention and the meditative unification of vital movement.
blocks.directed: These include inhalation, exhalation, retention and the meditative unification of vital movement.

blocks.text: The historical text really does prescribe breath practices. It’s not merely using the vocabulary metaphorically.
blocks.directed: The historical text really does prescribe breath practices. It’s not merely using the vocabulary metaphorically.

blocks.text: But the subtle-channel system is a traditional yogic framework, not an established anatomical network, and forceful breath retention is not something to improvise from an audiobook.
blocks.directed: But the subtle-channel system is a traditional yogic framework, not an established anatomical network, and forceful breath retention is not something to improvise from an audiobook.

blocks.text: For our purposes, the philosophical point is sufficient.
blocks.directed: For our purposes, the philosophical point is sufficient.

blocks.text: Ordinary vital activity is experienced through multiple differentiated functions.
blocks.directed: Ordinary vital activity is experienced through multiple differentiated functions.

blocks.text: The contemplative aim is their unification and withdrawal towards a subtler centre.
blocks.directed: The contemplative aim is their unification and withdrawal towards a subtler centre.

blocks.text:
Bhūtajaya — Mastery of the elements
Bhūta means an existent or element; here the gross elements.
blocks.directed:
Bhūtajaya — Mastery of the elements
Bhūta means an existent or element; here the gross elements.

blocks.text: Jaya means conquest or mastery.
blocks.directed: Jaya means conquest or mastery.

blocks.text: The five familiar elements are:
blocks.directed: [short pause] The five familiar elements are:

blocks.text: Earth.
blocks.directed: Earth.

blocks.text: Water.
blocks.directed: Water.

blocks.text: Fire.
blocks.directed: Fire.

blocks.text: Air.
blocks.directed: Air.

blocks.text: Space.
blocks.directed: Space.

blocks.text: In the tantric account, the practitioner employs specific dhāraṇās, concentrations, associated with these elements.
blocks.directed: In the tantric account, the practitioner employs specific dhāraṇās, concentrations, associated with these elements.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja cites the Svacchandatantra on their bodily locations and the extraordinary powers traditionally attributed to such practices.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja cites the Svacchandatantra on their bodily locations and the extraordinary powers traditionally attributed to such practices.

blocks.text: These include concentrating on air at the foot, fire near the navel, earth at the throat, water around the uvula and space at the crown of the head.
blocks.directed: These include concentrating on air at the foot, fire near the navel, earth at the throat, water around the uvula and space at the crown of the head.

blocks.text: It’s an unusual arrangement if you’re expecting a modern anatomy textbook.
blocks.directed: It’s an unusual arrangement if you’re expecting a modern anatomy textbook.

blocks.text: But this is ritual-yogic physiology, not ordinary physiology.
blocks.directed: But this is ritual-yogic physiology, not ordinary physiology.

blocks.text: And the text’s claims about mastery and supernatural accomplishments should be understood as traditional claims rather than demonstrated physical abilities.
blocks.directed: And the text’s claims about mastery and supernatural accomplishments should be understood as traditional claims rather than demonstrated physical abilities.

blocks.text:
Bhūtakaivalya — Withdrawal from the elements
Kaivalya conveys isolation or separateness.
blocks.directed:
Bhūtakaivalya — Withdrawal from the elements
Kaivalya conveys isolation or separateness.

blocks.text: Here Kṣemarāja associates the process with pratyāhāra.
blocks.directed: Here Kṣemarāja associates the process with pratyāhāra.

blocks.text: Withdrawal of attention from sensory objects.
blocks.directed: Withdrawal of attention from sensory objects.

blocks.text: Ordinarily, the mind rushes towards its objects.
blocks.directed: Ordinarily, the mind rushes towards its objects.

blocks.text: A sound arises.
blocks.directed: A sound arises.

blocks.text: Attention follows.
blocks.directed: Attention follows.

blocks.text: A smell arises.
blocks.directed: A smell arises.

blocks.text: Attention follows.
blocks.directed: Attention follows.

blocks.text: Your phone vibrates.
blocks.directed: Your phone vibrates.

blocks.text: The entire nervous system declares a state of emergency.
blocks.directed: The entire nervous system declares a state of emergency.

blocks.text: The practitioner deliberately withdraws from this outward dispersion.
blocks.directed: The practitioner deliberately withdraws from this outward dispersion.

blocks.text: Not because sensory experience is inherently evil.
blocks.directed: Not because sensory experience is inherently evil.

blocks.text: But because the mind is ordinarily dominated by its constant engagement with differentiated objects.
blocks.directed: But because the mind is ordinarily dominated by its constant engagement with differentiated objects.

blocks.text: The withdrawal creates a condition in which the source of awareness can become the focus.
blocks.directed: The withdrawal creates a condition in which the source of awareness can become the focus.

blocks.text:
Bhūtapṛthaktva — Separation from the elements
And here we arrive at the deepest point.
blocks.directed:
Bhūtapṛthaktva — Separation from the elements
And here we arrive at the deepest point.

blocks.text: Pṛthaktva means separation or distinctness.
blocks.directed: Pṛthaktva means separation or distinctness.

blocks.text: But this isn’t a denial of embodiment.
blocks.directed: But this isn’t a denial of embodiment.

blocks.text: It is the recognition that consciousness is not exhausted by the elements constituting embodied experience.
blocks.directed: It is the recognition that consciousness is not exhausted by the elements constituting embodied experience.

blocks.text: Earth, water, fire, air and space belong to the field of manifestation.
blocks.directed: Earth, water, fire, air and space belong to the field of manifestation.

blocks.text: The conscious reality in which they appear is not reducible, within this metaphysical system, to any one of them.
blocks.directed: The conscious reality in which they appear is not reducible, within this metaphysical system, to any one of them.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja associates this culmination with samādhi and recognition of the independent nature of consciousness.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja associates this culmination with samādhi and recognition of the independent nature of consciousness.

blocks.text: His discussion draws extensively on the Svacchandatantra, moving through prāṇāyāma, dhāraṇā, pratyāhāra and the transcendence of elemental identification. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: His discussion draws extensively on the Svacchandatantra, moving through prāṇāyāma, dhāraṇā, pratyāhāra and the transcendence of elemental identification. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.

blocks.text: And notice what we’ve done.
blocks.directed: And notice what we’ve done.

blocks.text: We began with ordinary embodied existence.
blocks.directed: We began with ordinary embodied existence.

blocks.text: Then moved through its vital functions.
blocks.directed: Then moved through its vital functions.

blocks.text: Then its elemental constitution.
blocks.directed: Then its elemental constitution.

blocks.text: Then withdrawal from identification with those elements.
blocks.directed: Then withdrawal from identification with those elements.

blocks.text: And finally towards the conscious reality underlying the entire process.
blocks.directed: And finally towards the conscious reality underlying the entire process.

blocks.text: This is Āṇavopāya in action.
blocks.directed: This is Āṇavopāya in action.

blocks.text: Starting from the limited individual.
blocks.directed: Starting from the limited individual.

blocks.text: Employing definite techniques.
blocks.directed: Employing definite techniques.

blocks.text: And moving towards recognition.
blocks.directed: And moving towards recognition.

blocks.text: But Vasugupta immediately issues another warning.
blocks.directed: But Vasugupta immediately issues another warning.

blocks.text: Because apparently the practitioner can get extremely good at these exercises and still completely miss the point.
blocks.directed: Because apparently the practitioner can get extremely good at these exercises and still completely miss the point.
